hints.title: Scalable Triplet Analysis
hints.text: Array length up to 10^5 requires linear O(n) time and 64-bit integer arithmetic to prevent overflow.

hints.title: Prefix Extremes
hints.text: Maintain max_i and max_diff = max(nums[i] - nums[j]) for all j < k.

hints.title: One Pass Accumulation
hints.text: For each element x at index k, evaluate max_diff * x, then update max_diff and max_i.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass with constant extra memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) and O(n^3) methods time out for n = 100,000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use online greedy prefix tracking with 64-bit precision.
